description.narrative: Urgent Action Fund - Africa is a feminist, Pan-African rapid response fund committed to transforming power relations through resourcing African feminist and women human rights defenders and their formations across the continent as an act of solidarity. They have deep and expanding knowledge, experience, and skills in the context in which women human rights defenders live, organize, work, and do their activism, urgent situations requiring rapid response, collective care and protection, feminist philanthropy, and movement building. It advocates for donor partners to understand, commit to, and actively invest in feminist and pan-African movements and formations.
